}

.sync-nav-action {
  border-color: rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.78);
  background: var(--blue);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.2);
}

.sync-nav-action:hover {
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--blue);
}

.notification-action {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 42px;
  min-height: 42px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: #244679;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.08);
}

.notification-action:hover,
.notification-action.has-unread {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.34);
  color: var(--pink);
  background: #fff6fb;
}

.notification-action svg {
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
}

.notification-dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: -6px;
  right: -6px;
  min-width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  padding: 0 5px;
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 2px solid #fff;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--pink);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.14);
}

.status-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(15, 169, 104, 0.12);
}

.online-pill.is-offline .status-dot {
  background: var(--red);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(204, 47, 74, 0.12);
}

.shell {
  padding: 46px 0 30px;
}

.home-shell {
  padding-top: 34px;
}

.hero {
  max-width: 690px;
  margin: 0 auto 28px;
  text-align: center;
}

.eyebrow {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: var(--pink);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

h1,
h2,
p {
  margin-top: 0;
}

h1 {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.8rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.hero p {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.menu-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}

.home-shell .menu-grid {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.feature-card {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
  gap: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 270px;
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96), rgba(247, 251, 255, 0.88)),
    var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  isolation: isolate;
  transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease;
}

.feature-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.09), transparent 34%),
    linear-gradient(315deg, rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.07), transparent 40%);
}

.feature-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 22px;
  right: 24px;
  width: 82px;
  height: 82px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.16);
  border-radius: 8px;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.feature-card > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.feature-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.34);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 54px rgba(17, 69, 134, 0.16);
}

.feature-attendance {
  border-top: 4px solid var(--blue);
}

.feature-medicine {
  border-top: 4px solid var(--pink);
}

.feature-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 58px;
  height: 58px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--blue);
  background: #e9f4ff;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.08);
}

.feature-medicine .feature-icon {
  color: var(--pink);
  background: #fff0f8;
}

.feature-icon svg {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
}

.menu-number {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.feature-card h2 {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  font-size: 1.55rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.feature-card p {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.quick-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-content: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.quick-list li {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface-soft);
  color: #244679;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.primary-action,
.secondary-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 9px;
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--blue);
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.25);
  transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease;
}

.primary-action:hover,
.secondary-action:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.28);
}

.primary-action.accent {
  background: var(--pink);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.24);
}

.notification-popover {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 5000;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 22px;
  background: rgba(8, 30, 73, 0.28);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.notification-card {
  position: relative;
  width: min(390px, 100%);
  padding: 22px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.92);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(17, 69, 134, 0.22);
}

.notification-card h2 {
  margin: 0 38px 8px 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.notification-card p,
.notification-message {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.notification-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.notification-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr) 28px;
  align-items: start;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 9px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.72);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(246, 250, 255, 0.86);
}

.notification-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
}

.notification-toolbar strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.notification-toolbar button,
.notification-delete {
  min-height: 28px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 71, 126, 0.28);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff2f6;
  color: #e1165b;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.notification-toolbar button {
  padding: 0 10px;
}

.notification-delete {
  width: 28px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 0;
}

.notification-delete svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2.4;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.notification-number {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.14), rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.14));
  color: var(--blue);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.notification-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.notification-body strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.notification-body small,
.notification-detail,
.notification-empty,
.notification-upload-note {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.notification-detail {
  display: block;
}

.notification-empty,
.notification-upload-note {
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.62);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
}

.notification-upload-note {
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.welcome-reminder-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 4200;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 22px;
  background: rgba(8, 25, 62, 0.42);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
}

.welcome-reminder-modal[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.welcome-reminder-card {
  width: min(100%, 430px);
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 0 34px 90px rgba(8, 25, 62, 0.28);
}

.welcome-reminder-mark {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.12), rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.12));
  color: var(--blue);
}

.welcome-reminder-mark svg {
  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2.2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.welcome-reminder-card h2,
.welcome-reminder-card h3,
.welcome-reminder-card p {
  margin: 0;
}

.welcome-reminder-card h2 {
  color: #08245c;
  font-size: 1.14rem;
}

.welcome-reminder-slide {
  display: none;
  gap: 8px;
}

.welcome-reminder-slide.is-active {
  display: grid;
}

.welcome-reminder-slide h3 {
  color: #0b3a89;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}

.welcome-reminder-slide p {
  color: #536b94;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.58;
}

.welcome-reminder-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
}

.text-reminder-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 4300;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: clamp(16px, 4vw, 36px);
  background: rgba(10, 22, 52, 0.54);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.text-reminder-modal[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.text-reminder-card {
  position: relative;
  width: min(92vw, 720px);
  max-height: min(88vh, 720px);
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(14px, 2.4vw, 22px);
  overflow: auto;
  padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 46px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(215, 226, 255, 0.92);
  border-radius: clamp(20px, 3vw, 34px);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgba(82, 76, 255, 0.14), transparent 36%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.12), transparent 34%),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  box-shadow: 0 34px 110px rgba(16, 31, 76, 0.32);
  color: #071b52;
}

.prayer-reminder-card {
  justify-items: center;
  text-align: center;
}

.text-reminder-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  right: 16px;
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(102, 89, 244, 0.24);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  color: #3524d8;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.text-reminder-close svg,
.reminder-pill svg {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2.4;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.text-reminder-close:focus-visible,
.reminder-primary:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(80, 74, 244, 0.45);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.reminder-pill {
  width: fit-content;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(82, 76, 255, 0.12), rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.10));
  color: #2620b6;
  font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.6vw, 1.02rem);
  font-weight: 800;
}

.text-reminder-card h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 5vw, 3.25rem);
  line-height: 1.12;
  color: #06125d;
}

.text-reminder-card p {
  max-width: 620px;
  margin: 0;
  color: #263f78;
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.8vw, 1.12rem);
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.reminder-lead {
  font-weight: 700;
}

.reminder-verse {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 620px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: clamp(16px, 3vw, 22px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(126, 135, 255, 0.22);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: rgba(246, 248, 255, 0.92);
  text-align: left;
}

.reminder-verse strong {
  color: #3b2ce5;
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.8vw, 1.15rem);
}

.reminder-primary {
  width: min(100%, 390px);
  min-height: 50px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, #364df4, #e81798);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(95, 67, 238, 0.28);
  font-size: clamp(0.98rem, 2.6vw, 1.1rem);
}

body.theme-dark .text-reminder-modal {
  background: rgba(0, 8, 24, 0.72);
}

body.theme-dark .text-reminder-card {
  border-color: rgba(81, 106, 163, 0.74);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgba(82, 76, 255, 0.20), transparent 38%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.16), transparent 36%),
    rgba(6, 16, 34, 0.98);
  color: #eef5ff;
}

body.theme-dark .text-reminder-card h2,
body.theme-dark .reminder-verse strong {
  color: #f5f8ff;
}

body.theme-dark .text-reminder-card p {
  color: #cfddf5;
}

body.theme-dark .reminder-pill,
body.theme-dark .reminder-verse,
body.theme-dark .text-reminder-close {
  border-color: rgba(97, 124, 184, 0.58);
  background: rgba(13, 29, 58, 0.92);
  color: #dfe7ff;
}

@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .text-reminder-card {
    width: min(94vw, 460px);
    max-height: 82vh;
    padding: 26px 18px 22px;
    border-radius: 22px;
  }

  .text-reminder-close {
    top: 12px;
    right: 12px;
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
  }

  .reminder-pill {
    margin-top: 10px;
  }
}

.notification-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  right: 12px;
}

.notification-confirm {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 40px;
}

.secondary-action {
  border: 1px solid var(--blue);
  background: var(--blue);
}

.scan-action,
.filter-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 9px;
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--blue-dark);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.scan-action:hover,
.filter-action:hover {
  border-color: rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(17, 69, 134, 0.08);
}

.filter-action.is-active {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.48);
  background: #fff6fb;
  color: var(--pink);
}

.footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 18px 0 24px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.search-shell {
  max-width: 960px;
}

.search-panel {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  padding: 22px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.search-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.search-heading h1 {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 2.7rem);
}

.search-popover-anchor {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 60;
  width: min(760px, 100%);
}

.icon-button {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--blue-dark);
}

.icon-button:hover {
  border-color: rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.45);
}

.search-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 680px) auto;
  gap: 10px;
}

.search-box {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 52px;
  padding: 0 6px 0 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--muted);
}

.search-box:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.12);
}

.search-box input,
.settings-row input {
  width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.search-box input::placeholder,
.settings-row input::placeholder {
  color: #7f94b1;
}

.search-scan-button {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border: 1px solid #d8e8fb;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #edf6ff;
  color: var(--blue-dark);
}

.search-scan-button:hover {
  border-color: rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.5);
  background: #e3f1ff;
}

.scanner-panel {
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #f8fbff;
}

.scanner-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.scanner-actions {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.flash-button.is-active {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.5);
  background: #fff0f8;
  color: var(--pink);
}

.scanner-head strong {
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}

.scanner-frame {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #081832;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
}

.scanner-frame::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 11%;
  right: 11%;
  top: 21%;
  bottom: 21%;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.38);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.scanner-frame video {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  cursor: crosshair;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}

.scan-line {
  position: absolute;
  left: 10%;
  right: 10%;
  top: 50%;
  z-index: 1;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--pink);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.65);
}

.scanner-panel p {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.scanner-panel p[data-type="success"] {
  color: var(--green);
}

.scanner-panel p[data-type="error"] {
  color: var(--red);
}

.filters-panel {
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #f8fbff;
}

.import-panel {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: min(560px, 100%);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(248, 251, 255, 0.92);
  box-shadow: none;
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
}

.import-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.import-head strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.import-head span,
.import-panel p {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.import-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(118px, 0.85fr) minmax(150px, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
}

.file-picker {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 34px;
  padding: 0 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: #244679;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.file-picker input {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.import-row select {
  min-height: 34px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  outline: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.import-row .secondary-action {
  min-height: 34px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.import-panel p {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
}

.import-panel p[data-type="success"] {
  color: var(--green);
}

.import-panel p[data-type="warning"] {
  color: var(--yellow);
}

.import-panel p[data-type="error"] {
  color: var(--red);
}

.filter-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.filter-head strong,
.column-filter strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}

.filter-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(158px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}

.filter-grid label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 7px;
  color: #244679;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.filter-grid input,
.filter-grid select {
  min-height: 42px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  outline: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: inherit;
  text-transform: none;
}

.filter-grid input:focus,
.filter-grid select:focus {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.1);
}

.column-filter {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid #dbe8f7;
}

.column-options {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.column-options label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: #244679;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.column-options input {
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  accent-color: var(--blue);
}

.settings-panel {
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px dashed #adc5e5;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #f8fbff;
}

.settings-panel label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  color: #244679;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.settings-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}

.settings-row input {
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
}

.text-button {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--red);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.meta-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 14px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

#cacheStatus[data-type="success"] {
  color: var(--green);
}

#cacheStatus[data-type="warning"] {
  color: var(--yellow);
}

#cacheStatus[data-type="error"] {
  color: var(--red);
}

.results-area {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 10px);
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  display: block;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
}

.results-popover {
  width: 100%;
  max-height: min(62vh, 650px);
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(207, 224, 244, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgba(7, 23, 52, 0.18);
}

.results-popover-head {
  position: sticky;
  top: -14px;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: -14px -14px 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5eef8;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.results-popover-head strong {
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.empty-state {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 260px;
  padding: 34px 22px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.empty-state svg {
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  color: var(--blue);
}

.empty-state h2 {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
}

.empty-state p {
  max-width: 420px;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.results-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
}

.medicine-card {
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(17, 69, 134, 0.08);
}

.medicine-main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.medicine-title {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}

.medicine-name-chip {
  display: inline-block;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 9px 12px 9px 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(207, 224, 244, 0.78);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--name-bg, #eef6ff);
  box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--name-accent, var(--blue));
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.medicine-name-chip.name-tone-1 {
  --name-bg: #eaf4ff;
  --name-accent: #1378ee;
}

.medicine-name-chip.name-tone-2 {
  --name-bg: #fff0f8;
  --name-accent: #e81798;
}

.medicine-name-chip.name-tone-3 {
  --name-bg: #eafaf1;
  --name-accent: #0fa968;
}

.medicine-name-chip.name-tone-4 {
  --name-bg: #fff7df;
  --name-accent: #d08a00;
}

.medicine-name-chip.name-tone-5 {
  --name-bg: #ecfbff;
  --name-accent: #0095b8;
}

.medicine-name-chip.name-tone-6 {
  --name-bg: #f3f0ff;
  --name-accent: #6b52d9;
}

.medicine-main h2 {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.medicine-main mark {
  padding: 0 4px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
  color: inherit;
}

.medicine-main p {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.stock-pill {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #eef3fa;
  color: #506986;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.stock-pill.neutral {
  background: #e7edf5;
  color: #334a67;
}

.stock-pill.success {
  background: #e7f7ef;
  color: #08764a;
}

.stock-pill.warning {
  background: #fff5d8;
  color: var(--yellow);
}

.stock-pill.danger {
  background: #ffe9ed;
  color: var(--red);
}

.medicine-review {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(280px, 0.8fr);
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: start;
}

.medicine-review.single-column {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}

.medicine-summary {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0;
}

.medicine-summary div {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 38px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5eef8;
}

.medicine-summary div:first-child {
  border-top: 1px solid #e5eef8;
}

.medicine-summary dt {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.medicine-summary dd {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.price-table {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #dbe8f7;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
}

.price-table-head,
.price-table-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 62px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}

.price-table-head {
  padding: 9px 12px;
  background: #edf5ff;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.price-table-row {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid #e5eef8;
}

.price-table-row span {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.price-table-row strong {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

body.has-search-popover .topbar,
body.has-search-popover .footer {
  display: none;
}

.results-popover {
  width: min(430px, 100%);
  max-height: min(74vh, 660px);
  padding: 10px;
}

.results-popover-head {
  margin: -10px -10px 10px;
  padding: 10px;
}

.results-popover-head strong {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.results-popover .medicine-card {
  padding: 12px;
  background: #fbfaff;
}

.results-popover .medicine-main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: start;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.results-popover .medicine-name-chip {
  padding: 6px 8px 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--name-accent, var(--blue));
}

.results-popover .medicine-main h2 {
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.28;
}

.results-popover .medicine-main p {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.results-popover .stock-pill {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.results-popover .medicine-review {
  display: block;
}

.results-popover .medicine-summary {
  gap: 0;
}

.results-popover .medicine-summary div {
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 3px 0;
  border: 0;
}

.results-popover .medicine-summary div:first-child {
  border-top: 0;
}

.results-popover .medicine-summary div:not([data-key="stock"]):not([data-key="expired"]) {
  display: none;
}

.results-popover .medicine-summary dt,
.results-popover .medicine-summary dd,
.results-popover .price-table-row span,
.results-popover .price-table-row strong {
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}

.results-popover .medicine-summary dt {
  color: var(--ink);
  text-transform: none;
}

.results-popover .medicine-summary dt::after {
  content: " :";
}

.results-popover .price-table {
  margin-top: 8px;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
}

.results-popover .price-table-head {
  display: none;
}

.results-popover .price-table-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 3px 0;
  border: 0;
}

.results-popover .price-level {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.results-popover .price-level::before {
  content: "Harga ";
}

.results-popover .price-level::after {
  content: " :";
}

.results-popover .price-value {
  order: 2;
}

.results-popover .price-unit {
  order: 3;
}

.results-popover .price-unit::before {
  content: " / ";
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 700;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  body {
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94), rgba(238, 247, 255, 0.96)),
      var(--bg);
  }

  .topbar {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .status-strip,
  .page-nav {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .top-actions {
    width: 100%;
    justify-items: stretch;
  }

  .menu-grid,
  .search-form,
  .settings-row,
  .import-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .results-popover {
    max-height: min(74vh, 660px);
    padding: 10px;
  }

  .results-popover-head {
    margin: -10px -10px 10px;
    padding: 10px;
  }

  .results-popover-head strong {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
  }

  .medicine-card {
    padding: 12px;
    background: #fbfaff;
  }

  .medicine-main {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: start;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .medicine-name-chip {
    padding: 6px 8px 6px 10px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--name-accent, var(--blue));
  }

  .medicine-main h2 {
    margin-bottom: 3px;
    font-size: 0.98rem;
    line-height: 1.28;
  }

  .medicine-main p {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
  }

  .stock-pill {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
  }

  .medicine-review {
    display: block;
  }

  .medicine-summary {
    gap: 0;
  }

  .medicine-summary div {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 6px;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 3px 0;
    border: 0;
  }

  .medicine-summary div:first-child {
    border-top: 0;
  }

  .medicine-summary div:not([data-key="stock"]):not([data-key="expired"]) {
    display: none;
  }

  .medicine-summary dt,
  .medicine-summary dd,
  .price-table-row span,
  .price-table-row strong {
    font-size: 0.86rem;
  }

  .medicine-summary dt {
    color: var(--ink);
    text-transform: none;
  }

  .medicine-summary dt::after {
    content: " :";
  }

  .price-table {
    margin-top: 8px;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
  }

  .price-table-head {
    display: none;
  }

  .price-table-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 3px 0;
    border: 0;
  }

  .price-level {
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  .price-level::before {
    content: "Harga ";
  }

  .price-level::after {
    content: " :";
  }

  .price-value {
    order: 2;
  }

  .price-unit {
    order: 3;
  }

  .price-unit::before {
    content: " / ";
    color: var(--ink);
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .feature-card {
    min-height: auto;
  }

  .footer {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 460px) {
  .topbar,
  .footer,
  .shell {
    width: min(100% - 22px, 1120px);
  }

  .brand strong,
  .brand small {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .status-item,
  .online-pill,
  .page-nav a,
  .nav-action {
    min-height: 36px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
  }

  .shell {
    padding-top: 34px;
  }

  .feature-card,
  .search-panel,
  .medicine-card {
    padding: 16px;
  }

  .medicine-main {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .price-table-head {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* Home mockup refresh */
body[data-page="home"] {
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(248, 252, 255, 0.96), rgba(237, 247, 255, 0.96)),
    url("https://nadhirafarma.github.io/absensi_apotek/logo.png") left 2vw top 150px / 170px auto no-repeat,
    var(--bg);
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

body[data-page="home"]::after {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 96px 0 auto;
  height: 580px;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.12), transparent 18%, transparent 82%, rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.12)),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 28%, rgba(55, 151, 255, 0.22), transparent 38%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 34%, rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.18), transparent 38%);
  opacity: 0.7;
  z-index: 0;
}

body[data-page="home"] .topbar,
body[data-page="home"] .footer,
body[data-page="home"] .shell {
  width: min(1420px, calc(100% - 42px));
}

body[data-page="home"] .topbar {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 0;
  padding: 12px 30px;
  border-width: 0 0 1px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.08);
}

.home-brand .brand-logo {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
}

.home-brand strong {
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.home-brand small {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.home-status-strip {
  gap: 12px;
}

body[data-page="home"] .online-pill,
body[data-page="home"] .status-item,
.profile-chip {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.72), 0 10px 24px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.06);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  color: #122a63;
}

body[data-page="home"] .status-item svg {
  color: var(--blue);
}

.profile-menu {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  z-index: 200;
}

.profile-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 0;
  transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease;
}

.profile-chip:hover,
.profile-chip.is-open {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.34), 0 12px 24px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.1);
}

.profile-chip svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
}

.profile-avatar {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1378ee, #e81798);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.2);
}

.profile-dropdown {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 10px);
  right: 0;
  z-index: 9999;
  pointer-events: auto;
  width: 258px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.92);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 48px rgba(17, 69, 134, 0.18);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

.profile-dropdown::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -7px;
  right: 22px;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.92);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.92);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.profile-summary {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 4px 2px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.65);
}

.profile-mini-avatar {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1378ee, #e81798);
}

.profile-summary strong,
.profile-summary small {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.profile-summary strong {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.profile-summary small {
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.logout-button {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10000;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 38px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.22);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff6fb;
  color: #c91582;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  pointer-events: auto;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.logout-button:hover {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.42);
  background: #fff0f8;
}

.logout-button svg {
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
}

.home-shell {
  padding: 30px 0 10px;
}

.home-hero {
  max-width: 1040px;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
  text-align: center;
}

.home-hero h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: clamp(1.55rem, 2.5vw, 2.05rem);
  line-height: 1.08;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.home-hero h1 span {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), #7f3ee8 48%, var(--pink));
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}

.home-hero p {
  position: relative;
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.home-hero p::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 102px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--pink));
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

body[data-page="home"] .menu-grid {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
}

body[data-page="home"] .home-menu-grid {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(160px, 0.86fr) minmax(160px, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 14px;
  min-height: 250px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.34);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), rgba(232, 244, 255, 0.78)),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
  box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgba(37, 94, 172, 0.18);
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-card::before {
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.16), transparent 46%),
    linear-gradient(315deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7), transparent 42%);
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-card::after {
  inset: 14px;
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
  border-radius: 8px;
  transform: none;
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 32px 84px rgba(37, 94, 172, 0.22);
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-attendance {
  border-top-width: 2px;
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-medicine {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.42);
  border-top-width: 2px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), rgba(255, 238, 248, 0.82)),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgba(173, 34, 132, 0.16);
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-content {
  display: grid;
  align-content: center;
  justify-items: start;
  min-height: 170px;
}

body[data-page="home"] .menu-number {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.22);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--blue);
  background: rgba(232, 244, 255, 0.92);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.12);
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-medicine .menu-number {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.22);
  color: var(--pink);
  background: rgba(255, 235, 247, 0.95);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.11);
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-card h2 {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 1.8vw, 1.3rem);
  line-height: 1.08;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.title-line {
  display: block;
  width: 18px;
  height: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--blue);
}

.feature-medicine .title-line {
  background: var(--pink);
}

body[data-page="home"] .feature-card p {
  max-width: 255px;
  margin-bottom: 34px;
  color: #536b96;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.72;
}

body[data-page="home"] .primary-action {
  min-width: 156px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.28);
}

body[data-page="home"] .primary-action.accent {
  box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.26);
}

.feature-visual {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-height: 176px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.feature-visual::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 18px 6px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.08) 1px, transparent 1px),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  background-size: 24px 24px;
  transform: perspective(600px) rotateX(9deg) rotateY(-8deg);
}

.scan-frame {
  position: absolute;
  width: 112px;
  height: 130px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(220, 238, 255, 0.85);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(94, 171, 255, 0.45);
}

.scan-frame::before,
.scan-frame::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -10px;
  border: 6px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: #cbe3ff;
  border-left-color: #cbe3ff;
  border-radius: 8px;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.46));
}

.scan-frame::after {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.face-head {
  position: relative;
  width: 72px;
  height: 92px;
  border-radius: 46% 46% 42% 42%;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), rgba(101, 169, 255, 0.42)),
    #b9d7ff;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -16px 28px rgba(36, 105, 196, 0.22), 0 18px 42px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.22);
}

.face-head::before,
.face-head::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 44px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(7, 41, 104, 0.42);
}

.face-head::before {
  left: 26px;
}

.face-head::after {
  right: 26px;
}

.scan-line {
  position: absolute;
  width: 160px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #44d7ff, #f73eb1, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(68, 215, 255, 0.9);
}

.shield-badge {
  position: absolute;
  right: 20px;
  bottom: 18px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 48px;
  height: 54px;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #77ceff, #1b82f0);
  clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 92% 20%, 86% 72%, 50% 100%, 14% 72%, 8% 20%);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 24px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.28));
}

.shield-badge svg {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
}

.medicine-visual::before {
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.08) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
}

.pill-capsule {
  position: absolute;
  width: 50px;
  height: 110px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, #ff4caf 0 50%, #ffffff 50% 100%);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34), 0 24px 46px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.26);
  transform: rotate(42deg) translate(-12px, -18px);
}

.lens {
  position: absolute;
  right: 30px;
  bottom: 40px;
  width: 62px;
  height: 62px;
  border: 6px solid rgba(33, 47, 111, 0.72);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 22px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.54), 0 18px 38px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.18);
}

.lens-handle {
  position: absolute;
  right: 14px;
  bottom: 26px;
  width: 42px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(33, 47, 111, 0.72), rgba(86, 101, 168, 0.88));
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  transform-origin: left center;
}

.data-orbit {
  position: absolute;
  width: 168px;
  height: 62px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.23);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: rotate(-9deg) translateY(36px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.18);
}

.feature-points {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 18px 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(137, 171, 217, 0.22);
  list-style: none;
}

.feature-points li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.feature-points svg {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  padding: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.22);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--blue);
  background: rgba(238, 247, 255, 0.82);
}

.feature-medicine .feature-points svg {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.22);
  color: var(--pink);
  background: rgba(255, 239, 249, 0.84);
}

.feature-points span {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.feature-points strong {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.feature-points small {
  color: #60779d;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.home-footer {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 8px 20px 10px;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}

.home-footer span:last-child {
  justify-self: end;
}

.secure-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 34px;
  padding: 7px 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(193, 211, 237, 0.78);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);
  color: #5b7197;
}

.secure-pill svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

@media (max-width: 1050px) {
  body[data-page="home"] .menu-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    max-width: 760px;
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .feature-card {
    min-height: 310px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  body[data-page="home"] {
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(248, 252, 255, 0.97), rgba(237, 247, 255, 0.97)),
      var(--bg);
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .topbar,
  body[data-page="home"] .footer,
  body[data-page="home"] .shell {
    width: min(100% - 24px, 1420px);
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .topbar {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 14px 12px;
  }

  .home-brand .brand-logo {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
  }

  .home-brand strong {
    font-size: 1.02rem;
  }

  .home-brand small {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
  }

  .home-status-strip {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .online-pill,
  body[data-page="home"] .status-item {
    min-height: 40px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
  }

  .profile-menu {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    justify-self: end;
  }

  .profile-chip {
    min-height: 40px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
  }

  .profile-avatar {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    font-size: 0.66rem;
  }

  .profile-dropdown {
    width: min(258px, calc(100vw - 28px));
  }

  .home-shell {
    padding-top: 26px;
  }

  .home-hero {
    margin-bottom: 22px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .home-hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(1rem, 4.35vw, 1.55rem);
  }

  .home-hero p {
    padding-bottom: 20px;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  .home-hero p::after {
    left: 50%;
    width: 96px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .feature-card {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 118px;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 18px;
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .feature-content {
    min-height: 0;
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .menu-number {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-size: 0.86rem;
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .feature-card h2 {
    font-size: 1.18rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .feature-card p {
    max-width: none;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .primary-action {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 50px;
    font-size: 0.96rem;
  }

  .feature-visual {
    min-height: 150px;
    order: 2;
  }

  .feature-content {
    order: 1;
  }

  .feature-points {
    order: 3;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
    padding-top: 14px;
  }

  .feature-points li {
    min-height: 42px;
  }

  .scan-frame {
    width: 92px;
    height: 110px;
  }

  .face-head {
    width: 58px;
    height: 76px;
  }

  .scan-line {
    width: 126px;
  }

  .shield-badge {
    right: 8px;
    bottom: 18px;
    width: 42px;
    height: 48px;
  }

  .pill-capsule {
    width: 44px;
    height: 96px;
  }

  .lens {
    right: 18px;
    bottom: 36px;
    width: 52px;
    height: 52px;
    border-width: 6px;
  }

  .lens-handle {
    right: 8px;
    bottom: 24px;
    width: 34px;
  }

  .data-orbit {
    width: 118px;
    height: 50px;
  }

  .home-footer {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    justify-items: center;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .home-footer span:last-child {
    justify-self: center;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 390px) {
  .home-status-strip {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .home-hero h1 {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
  }

  body[data-page="home"] .feature-card {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    padding: 14px;
  }

  .feature-visual {
    display: none;
  }
}

body.dashboard-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.055) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fbff 0%, #ffffff 48%, #fff2fb 100%);
  background-size: 48px 48px, 48px 48px, auto;
}

.app-layout {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 236px minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.app-sidebar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: 26px 20px;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(207, 224, 244, 0.9);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  box-shadow: 14px 0 44px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.06);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

.sidebar-brand {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.sidebar-brand img {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.sidebar-brand strong,
.sidebar-brand small {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sidebar-brand strong {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.sidebar-brand small {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.sidebar-nav {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.sidebar-section {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 16px 0 6px;
  color: #58709b;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.sidebar-section::after {
  content: "";
  height: 1px;
  flex: 1;
  background: #d9e6f7;
}

.sidebar-link,
.sidebar-logout {
  min-height: 44px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 11px 12px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: #001f72;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.sidebar-link svg,
.sidebar-logout svg {
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
}

.sidebar-link:hover,
.sidebar-link.is-active {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.16);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.08), rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.13));
  color: #1247df;
  box-shadow: inset -3px 0 0 var(--pink);
}

.sidebar-logout {
  margin-top: auto;
  justify-content: center;
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.2);
  background: #fff6fb;
  color: #c91582;
}

.sidebar-logout:hover {
  border-color: rgba(232, 23, 152, 0.42);
  background: #fff0f8;
}

.sidebar-copy {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.dashboard-main {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 26px 28px 30px;
}

.dashboard-topbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 40;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.dashboard-topbar h1 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2.2vw, 1.8rem);
}

.dashboard-topbar p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}

.dashboard-status {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.dashboard-status .status-item,
.dashboard-status .online-pill {
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}

.profile-name {
  max-width: 120px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.dashboard-content {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
}

.dashboard-stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}

.stat-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 54px minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  min-height: 104px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(207, 224, 244, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.07);
}

.stat-card[role="button"] {
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
}

.stat-card[role="button"]:hover,
.stat-card[role="button"]:focus-visible {
  border-color: rgba(39, 115, 236, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 58px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.12);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  outline: none;
}

.stat-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 54px;
  height: 54px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.stat-icon svg {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
}

.stat-blue {
  color: var(--blue);
  background: #edf5ff;
}

.stat-purple {
  color: #6e36ff;
  background: #f2ecff;
}

.stat-orange {
  color: #f07b17;
  background: #fff2e8;
}

.stat-pink {
  color: var(--pink);
  background: #fff0f8;
}

.stat-card small,
.stat-card em {
  display: block;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-style: normal;
}

.stat-card strong {
  display: block;
  margin: 3px 0;
  color: #001f72;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
}

.data-workspace {
  min-width: 0;
}

.data-toolbar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 1fr) auto auto;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.dashboard-search {
  min-height: 46px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--surface);
}

.dashboard-search svg {
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.dashboard-search input {
  width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  font: inherit;
}

.dashboard-link-button {
  min-height: 46px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.table-card {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(207, 224, 244, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.08);
}

.table-headline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dfeaf8;
}

.table-headline h2 {
  margin: 0 0 5px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}

.table-headline p,
.table-headline span {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

#dashboardStatusText[data-type="success"] {
  color: #079f60;
}

#dashboardStatusText[data-type="error"] {
  color: #d92a55;
}

.dashboard-table-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  overflow: auto;
}

.dashboard-table {
  width: max-content;
  min-width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.dashboard-table th,
.dashboard-table td {
  max-width: 230px;
  padding: 13px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5eef8;
  color: #14336d;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.dashboard-table th {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  background: #f8fbff;
  color: #001f72;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.dashboard-table td {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
}

.dashboard-table tr:hover td {
  background: #f8fbff;
}

.empty-table-cell {
  text-align: center !important;
  color: var(--muted) !important;
}

.dashboard-table-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.pagination-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.pagination-actions span {
  min-width: 34px;
  min-height: 34px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--blue);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--blue);
  font-weight: 700;
}

@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .dashboard-stats {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .dashboard-topbar {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .dashboard-status {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .app-layout {
    display: block;
  }

  .app-sidebar {
    position: relative;
    min-height: auto;
    padding: 18px;
    border-right: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(207, 224, 244, 0.9);
  }

  .sidebar-nav {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .sidebar-section {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .sidebar-logout {
    margin-top: 0;
  }

  .dashboard-main {
    padding: 18px;
  }

  .data-toolbar {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .dashboard-main {
    padding: 14px;
  }

  .sidebar-nav,
  .dashboard-stats {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .dashboard-status {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .dashboard-status .status-item,
  .dashboard-status .online-pill,
  .dashboard-status .profile-menu,
  .dashboard-status .profile-chip {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .profile-dropdown {
    right: 0;
    left: auto;
    width: min(100vw - 36px, 300px);
  }

  .table-headline,
  .dashboard-table-footer {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

/* Admin dashboard shell */
.app-layout {
  grid-template-columns: 286px minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.app-sidebar {
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 30;
}

.sidebar-brand-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
}

.sidebar-brand {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.sidebar-brand img {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.sidebar-brand-text {
  min-width: 0;
}

.sidebar-brand-text strong {
  overflow: visible;
  white-space: normal;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.sidebar-toggle {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  flex: 0 0 38px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(173, 205, 244, 0.9);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  color: #06235f;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.sidebar-toggle svg {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}

.sidebar-link {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
}

.sidebar-link svg {
  width: 21px;
  height: 21px;
  flex: 0 0 21px;
}

.sidebar-label {
  min-width: 0;
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .app-layout {
  grid-template-columns: 82px minmax(0, 1fr);
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .app-sidebar {
  padding-right: 14px;
  padding-left: 14px;
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand-row {
  justify-content: center;
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  justify-content: center;
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand-text,
body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-label,
body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-section {
  display: none;
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-link {
  justify-content: center;
  padding-right: 0;
  padding-left: 0;
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  right: 10px;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
}

.dashboard-topbar {
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 40;
}

.dashboard-title h1 {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.dashboard-status {
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-left: auto;
}

.profile-menu {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 100;
}

.profile-chip {
  min-width: 138px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.profile-dropdown {
  z-index: 500;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.notification-action {
  position: relative;
}

.dashboard-view {
  display: none;
}

.dashboard-view.is-active {
  display: block;
}

.data-toolbar {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(320px, 1fr) auto auto auto;
}

.compact-toolbar {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 1fr) minmax(170px, auto) minmax(170px, auto);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.barcode-search-icon {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #1f7bea !important;
}

.dashboard-filter-panel {
  position: relative;
  margin: -4px 0 16px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(247, 251, 255, 0.96);
}

.dashboard-filter-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.dashboard-filter-grid label,
.medicine-form-grid label,
.form-grid label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 7px;
  color: #17356c;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.dashboard-filter-grid select,
.medicine-form-grid input,
.medicine-form-grid select,
.medicine-form-grid textarea,
.form-grid input,
.form-grid select,
.form-grid textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #092965;
  font: inherit;
}

.medicine-form-grid textarea,
.form-grid textarea {
  resize: vertical;
}

.column-filter {
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid #dceafa;
}

.column-filter strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: #06235f;
}

.dashboard-column-options {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.dashboard-column-options label {
  min-height: 38px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #c7dcf6;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  color: #163775;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.dashboard-filter-panel .text-button {
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.dashboard-table {
  table-layout: auto;
}

.dashboard-table th,
.dashboard-table td {
  max-width: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.dashboard-table th[data-column="nama"],
.dashboard-table td[data-column="nama"] {
  min-width: 310px;
  max-width: 390px;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  line-height: 1.45;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.dashboard-table th[data-column="kategori"],
.dashboard-table td[data-column="kategori"],
.dashboard-table th[data-column="suplier"],
.dashboard-table td[data-column="suplier"] {
  min-width: 160px;
  max-width: 240px;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.dashboard-table th[data-column="indikasi"],
.dashboard-table td[data-column="indikasi"],
.dashboard-table th[data-column="komposisi"],
.dashboard-table td[data-column="komposisi"] {
  min-width: 240px;
  max-width: 360px;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.col-no {
  width: 58px;
  min-width: 58px;
}

.col-actions {
  position: sticky;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 112px;
  min-width: 112px;
  background: #f8fbff !important;
}

td.col-actions {
  background: #fff !important;
}

.row-actions {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.table-action {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #cfe0f4;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.table-action svg {
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
}

.table-action-edit {
  color: #1d5ddc;
}

.table-action-delete {
  color: #f0186b;
  background: #fff7fb;
  border-color: #ffd0e2;
}

.dashboard-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 900;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 24px;
  background: rgba(4, 20, 64, 0.42);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.dashboard-modal[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.modal-card {
  width: min(100%, 720px);
  max-height: calc(100vh - 48px);
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 22px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(205, 223, 247, 0.96);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(23, 61, 123, 0.22);
}

.modal-card-wide {
  width: min(100%, 1060px);
}

.record-modal-card {
  width: min(100%, 660px);
}

.modal-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.modal-head h2 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  color: #06235f;
}

.modal-head p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #5d729a;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}

.modal-head p[data-type="error"] {
  color: #d92a55;
}

.modal-head p[data-type="success"] {
  color: #079f60;
}

.form-grid,
.medicine-form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.medicine-form-grid {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.span-2 {
  grid-column: span 2;
}

.unit-field.is-hidden {
  display: none;
}

.form-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

.form-spacer {
  flex: 1;
}

.danger-action {
  min-height: 42px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border: 1px solid #ffbfd7;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff2f7;
  color: #e21364;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.module-card {
  padding: 22px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(207, 224, 244, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(31, 82, 151, 0.08);
}

.module-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.module-head h2 {
  margin: 0 0 5px;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.module-head p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.module-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(320px, 0.9fr);
  gap: 18px;
}

.simple-table-wrap {
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid #e1ebf8;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.simple-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 420px;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.simple-table th,
.simple-table td {
  padding: 13px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5eef8;
  color: #14336d;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.simple-table th {
  background: #f8fbff;
  color: #001f72;
}

.simple-name-button {
  width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #062e7f;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.simple-name-button:hover,
.simple-name-button:focus-visible {
  color: var(--blue);
  text-decoration: underline;
  outline: none;
}

.pill-tag,
.status-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 26px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #f0eafe;
  color: #6030d9;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.status-badge {
  background: #dcfaea;
  color: #079f60;
}

.status-badge.is-inactive {
  background: #ffe8f2;
  color: #e21364;
}

.profile-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(240px, 0.72fr) minmax(0, 1.45fr) minmax(260px, 0.8fr);
  gap: 18px;
}

.profile-card {
  padding: 28px 22px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(207, 224, 244, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
  text-align: center;
}

.profile-avatar-large {
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0 auto 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1f7bea, #f0129b);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(130, 38, 213, 0.28);
}

.profile-card h2 {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  color: #06235f;
}

.profile-card p {
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.profile-card dl {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0;
  text-align: left;
}

.profile-card dl div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid #e5eef8;
}

.profile-card dt {
  color: #5d729a;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.profile-card dd {
  margin: 0;
  color: #14336d;
}

.security-card {
  display: grid;
  align-content: start;
  gap: 12px;
}

.security-card button {
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #d7e5f8;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #14336d;
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.po-items,
.po-saved-list,
.report-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.po-item,
.po-saved-card,
.report-list article {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid #e2ecf8;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #14336d;
}

.po-item span,
.report-list span {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.po-item small,
.po-saved-card small,
.report-list small {
  color: var(--muted);
}

.po-item button {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #e21364;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.report-stats {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .data-toolbar,
  .dashboard-filter-grid,
  .medicine-form-grid,
  .profile-layout,
  .module-grid,
  .report-stats {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .app-layout,
  body.sidebar-collapsed .app-layout {
    display: block;
  }

  body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand-text,
  body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-label,
  body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-section {
    display: inline;
  }

  body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-link {
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding-right: 14px;
    padding-left: 14px;
  }

  body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-toggle {
    position: static;
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
  }

  .data-toolbar,
  .compact-toolbar,
  .dashboard-filter-grid,
  .medicine-form-grid,
  .form-grid,
  .profile-layout,
  .module-grid,
  .report-stats {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .shift-day-group > div {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .shift-rule-card {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .span-2 {
    grid-column: auto;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .shift-rule-card {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* Responsive polish for the admin dashboard. */
.dashboard-page,
.app-layout,
.dashboard-main,
.dashboard-content,
.dashboard-view {
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

.dashboard-main,
.dashboard-content,
.data-workspace,
.table-card,
.module-card,
.profile-card,
.stat-card {
  min-width: 0;
}

.data-workspace,
.table-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.table-card {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dashboard-table-wrap,
.simple-table-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.dashboard-table {
  width: max-content;
  min-width: 100%;
  table-layout: auto;
}

.dashboard-table th,
.dashboard-table td {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.dashboard-table th[data-column="nama"],
.dashboard-table td[data-column="nama"] {
  min-width: 280px;
  max-width: 360px;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.dashboard-stats,
.report-stats {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand-row {
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand {
  display: none;
}

body.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-toggle {
  position: static;
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
}

.profile-layout {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(230px, 0.72fr) minmax(360px, 1.35fr) minmax(230px, 0.76fr);
  align-items: start;
}

.profile-card dl div {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: start;
}

.profile-card dd {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  text-align: right;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.profile-layout .form-grid {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.profile-layout .form-grid .span-2 {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.profile-layout .form-actions {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.user-management-grid {
  display: block;
}

.user-management-grid > .module-card {
  width: 100%;
}

.compact-toolbar {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 1fr) minmax(150px, 210px) minmax(150px, 210px);
  align-items: center;
}

.compact-toolbar select {
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  outline: 0;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  color: #092965;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.simple-table th,
.simple-table td {

}

.simple-table th:nth-child(2),
.simple-table td:nth-child(2) {
  min-width: 190px;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {

  body.sidebar-collapsed .app-layout {

    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  .app-sidebar {

    top: 0;

@media (max-width: 560px) {

  .online-pill,

.sidebar-scrim {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 900;
  background: rgba(8, 30, 73, 0.28);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.sidebar-scrim[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.import-page {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  max-width: 920px;
}

.import-page-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 1fr) minmax(240px, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: end;
}

.import-page-grid label:not(.file-picker) {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  color: #14336d;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.import-page-grid select {
  min-height: 46px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.95);
  border-radius: 8px;
  outline: 0;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  color: #092965;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.import-file-picker {
  min-height: 46px;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}

.import-summary-card {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.85);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(248, 251, 255, 0.9);
}

.import-summary-card strong {
  color: #092965;
}

.import-summary-card p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.import-summary-card p[data-type="success"] {
  color: #079f60;
}

.import-summary-card p[data-type="warning"],
.import-summary-card p[data-type="info"] {
  color: #705b08;
}

.import-summary-card p[data-type="error"] {
  color: #d92a55;
}

.notification-popover {
  position: fixed;
  inset: auto;
  z-index: 5200;
  display: block;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  backdrop-filter: none;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.notification-popover[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.notification-card {
  width: 100%;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.notification-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  right: 34px;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.92);
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(185, 207, 238, 0.92);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.profile-modern-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(240px, 0.72fr) minmax(0, 1.55fr);
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}

.profile-overview-card {
  position: sticky;
  top: 20px;
}

.profile-settings-card {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
}

.profile-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.85);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(248, 251, 255, 0.82);
}

.profile-tab {
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #516994;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.profile-tab.is-active {
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, #1f7bea, #e81798);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(31, 123, 234, 0.22);
}

.profile-panel {
  display: none;
}

.profile-panel.is-active {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.profile-status {
  min-height: 20px;
  margin: -6px 0 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.profile-status[data-type="success"] {
  color: #079f60;
}

.profile-status[data-type="error"] {
  color: #d92a55;
}

.profile-status[data-type="info"] {
  color: #1f7bea;
}

.security-form,
.setting-row,
.activity-list article {
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.85);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(248, 251, 255, 0.86);
}

.security-form h3,
.compact-head h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #092965;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.setting-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
}

.setting-row span {
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
}

.setting-row strong {
  color: #092965;
}

.setting-row small,
.compact-head p {
  color: var(--muted);
}

.setting-row input[type="checkbox"] {
  width: 46px;
  height: 26px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  accent-color: #1f7bea;
}

.shift-rules-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.shift-rules-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

.shift-day-group {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.shift-day-group h4 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--blue-dark);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}

.shift-day-group > div {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.shift-rule-card {
  min-width: 0;

  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;

}

}

  font-weight: 700;
}

.shift-rule-card input {
  width: 100%;

  padding: 8px 10px;

}

.activity-list {

}

.activity-list p {

.activity-list article {

}

.activity-list span {

}

.activity-list strong {

}

.activity-list small,
.activity-list time {

.compact-head {

body.compact-dashboard .dashboard-main {

@media (max-width: 900px) {

.data-workspace > .data-toolbar {

  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.92);

}

.muted-action {

.scanner-modal-card {

}

.record-access-field {

.record-access-field > span {

}

.access-picker {

.access-picker label {

  place-items: center;

}

.password-validity-icon {

  right: 48px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.password-validity-icon svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  stroke-width: 3;
}

.password-validity-icon.is-valid {
  background: #e8fff2;
  color: #12a85e;
}

.password-validity-icon.is-invalid {
  background: #fff0f2;

.app-loading-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2147483600;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 24px;
  background: rgba(8, 25, 58, 0.34);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.app-loading-overlay[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.app-loading-card {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  min-width: 220px;
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 214, 247, 0.55);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  color: #092965;
  box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(17, 69, 134, 0.26);
}

.app-loading-orbit {
  position: relative;
  width: 76px;
  height: 76px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}

.app-loading-orbit::before,
.app-loading-orbit::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--blue);
  border-right-color: var(--pink);
  animation: nadhiraSpin 1.15s linear infinite;
}

.app-loading-orbit::after {
  inset: 9px;
  animation-duration: 0.82s;
  animation-direction: reverse;
  border-top-color: rgba(15, 169, 104, 0.95);
  border-right-color: rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.8);
}

.app-loading-orbit img {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  object-fit: contain;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(19, 120, 238, 0.24));
}

@keyframes nadhiraSpin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

  background: transparent;
}

  #view-data-obat.is-active .data-workspace > .data-toolbar .filter-action svg,
  #view-data-obat.is-active .data-workspace > .data-toolbar .secondary-action svg {
